title: 第一卷 第23章 妖兽王第一卷 第24章 绝世一剑
content_zh:
嗤！
一道剑气从天而降，距离叶寒本体不过三寸。
他能感觉后背被剑气锋芒所撕裂，寒气入骨，令人发悚。
“叶寒，你若是现在跪下来求饶，我就给你一个机会活命。”
天穹上方，罗天征站在飞天云豹身上，嘴角勾起一抹嘲弄。
罗天征随意斩出一剑，犹如猫戏老鼠。
“罗天征，你若能及时悔改，跪在我面前自己抽一百个嘴巴子，我也可以放过你。”
叶寒嘴上不饶人。
他的念头变幻，无数个对策涌现，可随之又被抹掉，差距太大，找不到任何机会。
尤其是那飞天云豹，比狮血宝马高贵了不知多少个档次，速度无比之快，在虚空之中还不曾有林木遮挡。
“嗯？飞天云豹？”
叶寒的眼前一亮，顿时掠过一抹寒光。
神力境，也不可能脚踩天地御空而行，罗天征和叶芷萱能傲立虚空，全凭站在飞天云豹的身上。
“给我滚下来。”
叶寒抓起一块十多斤重的石头，元力贯穿右臂，锁定了那飞天云豹。
猛然一掷，他所有的力量全部喧泄而出。
石头逆空而上，势如破竹！
上方半空中，飞天云豹发出痛苦的嘶吼，身躯开始颤抖，摇摇晃晃，右翼生生被砸出一个血洞。
“飞天？老子让你飞！”
叶寒一击得手，看到了希望。

第二块石头轰然砸出，狂暴的力量灌涌其中，让这石头轰出去的爆发力十足。
嗷……！
云豹在嘶吼，愤怒中带着悲鸣。
不过是一头妖兽坐骑而已，除了能飞在空中，这飞天云豹本身其实品级不高，也就勉强达到三阶妖兽的样子，哪里扛得住叶寒这种力量？
第三块、第四块！
连续四块坚石在那飞天云豹身上撞得粉碎，云豹咆哮，鲜血不断洒落。
“叶寒，你给我住手！”
罗天征气急败坏，身子随着飞天云豹摇摇晃晃，时刻就要掉下来。
“白痴！”
content_en:
laugh!
A sword energy fell from the sky, only three inches away from Ye Han's body.
He could feel his back being torn apart by the edge of the sword energy, and the cold air penetrated into his bones, which was terrifying.
"Ye Han, if you kneel down and beg for mercy now, I will give you a chance to survive."
Above the sky, Luo Tianzheng stood on the Flying Clouded Leopard, with a hint of mockery on his lips.
Luo Tianzheng slashed out his sword at will, like a cat playing with a mouse.
"Luo Tianzheng, if you can repent in time and kneel in front of me and slap yourself a hundred times, I can let you go."
Ye Han was unforgiving.
His thoughts changed, and countless countermeasures emerged, but they were wiped out immediately. The gap was too big and there was no chance.
Especially the flying clouded leopard, which is infinitely more noble than the lion-blooded BMW. Its speed is extremely fast, and there are no trees to block it in the void.
"Huh? Flying Clouded Leopard?"
Ye Han's eyes lit up, and a cold light flashed across his eyes.
In the realm of divine power, it is impossible to walk in the air with one's feet on the sky and the earth. Luo Tianzheng and Ye Zhixuan can stand proudly in the void only by standing on the flying clouded leopard.
"Get off here."
Ye Han grabbed a stone weighing more than ten kilograms, and his energy penetrated his right arm, locking on the flying clouded leopard.
With a sudden throw, all his strength was released.
The stone flies up into the sky like a broken bamboo!
In the mid-air above, the Flying Clouded Leopard roared in pain, its body began to tremble and stagger, and a bloody hole was smashed out of its right wing.
"Flying? I want you to fly!"
Ye Han succeeded with one blow and saw hope.
The second stone was smashed out, and violent power poured into it, making the stone blast out with full explosive power.
Ouch...!
The clouded leopard roared, angry and mournful.
It's just a monster mount. In addition to being able to fly in the air, the Flying Clouded Leopard itself is actually not of a high level. It can barely reach the level of a third-level monster. How can it withstand Ye Han's power?
The third piece, the fourth piece!
Four consecutive rocks smashed into pieces on the flying clouded leopard. The clouded leopard roared and blood continued to spill.
"Ye Han, stop it!"
Luo Tianzheng was furious, his body was swaying with the flying clouded leopard, and he was about to fall down at any moment.
"idiot!"
